about: axe-core rule id -> plain-words contract clause. Loaded by uat_driver.cjs; override the file with UAT_CONTRACT_MAP. Any rule not listed here falls back to 'general accessibility (no contract clause mapped for this rule)'.

rules.link-name: every interactive element needs an accessible name
rules.button-name: every interactive element needs an accessible name
rules.aria-command-name: every interactive element needs an accessible name
rules.label: form fields need an accessible name/label
rules.heading-order: real heading hierarchy, no skipped levels
rules.focus-order-semantics: focus order follows semantic source order
